data.content_ref: inline:The parity-gate framing is internally inconsistent with the refutation clause: the relation is 'REFUTED IF ... it does not apply a parity check as a gate but only as a post-hoc filter on the output triple.' This concedes the critical distinction (gate vs. filter) is load-bearing, but the body never establishes a causal mechanism by which the parity check gates the derivation — it merely asserts the neighborhood emits 48 because 138/3=46 is even. If the parity observation is downstream (a filter on already-formed triples), the dependence relation survives but the specific 'gate' augmentation claim is unsupported. The target names no mechanism distinguishing a gate that blocks derivation from a post-hoc filter that rejects odd results, so the substantive augmentation claim is unproven.
